name: What is the typical process for storm flood damage restoration?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for storm flood damage restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: The restoration process typically begins with an assessment of the damage. This is followed by water extraction using powerful pumps and vacuums. Next, specialized drying equipment, such as dehumidifiers and air movers, is used to remove residual moisture from affected materials and structural elements. Cleaning and sanitizing contaminated areas are crucial steps. Finally, restoration involves repairing or rebuilding damaged structures and contents to pre-loss condition, ensuring your home is safe and habitable.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves damage assessment, water extraction, structural drying, cleaning, sanitizing, and final repairs to restore your home.
